centre.reprime_invitation: Today, the center you are working with is your inner authority: trusting your own knowledge, without confirming it with others. You know more than you believe.

dynamique_ego.passion_explication: A dull, mental fear: fear of danger, of support giving way, of error, of what is hidden. It feeds permanent doubt — about others, about oneself, about what one believes one knows.
dynamique_ego.compulsion_evitement: Avoiding finding oneself alone, without support, without a framework.
dynamique_ego.peur_de_base: Being without support, without a guide, lost.
dynamique_ego.desir_de_base: Having a safe framework, a reliable authority, a compass.

essence.qualite_phrase: You don't have to foresee everything — you are already carried.
horizons: Recognizing support when it comes — without doubting it
Feeling the inner foundation that cannot be seen
Acting despite fear, not against it

intentions_du_matin: Not ask for one more opinion — decide alone
Recognize a support without testing it
Suspend the catastrophe scenario for a few hours
Find my own voice in a situation
See the real danger, not the imagined danger
Honor my loyalty to something that deserves it
pratiques_du_matin: Before noon, make a decision without consulting anyone.
When a catastrophe scenario rises, tell it: 'thank you, noted. Now back to the present.'
Feel the ground under your feet. You are carried — it's a fact, not a promise.
Ask for support clearly — and accept that it's given to you.
Identify one thing you are certain of. Return to it as a foothold.
Do one small new thing — to train courage.

zones.description: Living faith. You have your own compass. Fear passes without taking hold of you. You are reliable because you rely on what doesn't change.
You doubt, you anticipate, but you function. You recognize fear when it speaks — you don't always follow it.
Fear drives. You test endlessly, you script scenarios, you oscillate between dependence and defiance. Doubt paralyzes.
Panic, paranoia, blockage. The ground seems to have disappeared. A very heavy day that calls for a simple, solid support.

details_riso.texte: Courageous, confident, living faith. You are your own support — so you can be one for others.
Reliable, faithful, engaged. You work for cohesion without depending on approval.
Cooperative, responsible, organized. Fear makes you vigilant, not paralyzed.
Ambivalent, you seek the authority of reference. Doubt begins.
Anxious, reactive, distrustful. You test endlessly. Catastrophe scenarios abound.
Defensive, aggressive or over-dependent. You oscillate between counterphobic and over-compliant.
Panicked, desperate, self-destructive behaviors to escape anxiety.
Paranoia, hysteria, masochistic ideas. You attack what you fear losing.
Total collapse, self-sabotage. Asking for help is vital here.

passions.label: I played out the catastrophe scenario
passions.detail: And it came into my flesh.

passions.label: I tested a loved one's loyalty
I doubted what I knew
passions.detail: To the point of doing nothing anymore.

passions.label: I consulted too many opinions
passions.detail: To the point of losing my own.

passions.label: I dug in against an authority
passions.detail: More to resist than for any other reason.

pieges.label: I didn't decide — I let it pass
I stayed vigilant for no reason
I refused real support
pieges.detail: Too hard to believe in it.

pieges.label: I minimized an achievement
pieges.detail: So as not to tempt fate.

moments.label: I felt a quiet faith in myself
The present felt safe, not threatening
I recognized a support and welcomed it
My own voice made itself heard
I felt that I was carried, not alone

evenements_a_relire.label: I played out the catastrophe scenario
I consulted too much or too little

remedes.label: Faith — without content, just the support
Presence — the true antidote to the scenario
Support — welcoming it when it comes

matin: Morning begins. What is certain today, truly?
A day opens — what courage already dwells in you?
What do you want to decide — without consulting?
midi: You are in the middle of the day. Has fear been a guide or a cage?
Here you are. What support was there, that you didn't see?
A pause is possible. Feel your footholds.
soir: The day fades. What do you know, that you knew without knowing it?
You can just come, without anticipating anything.
The evening is gentle. The ground is still there.
nuit: The night watches. One thing to entrust, then sleep.
You are still here — that is already faith.
